title: 08 Rallo: app-download footer with a phone peeking up
strengths: The phone screen is a believable tempo-run view: distance ring, 6.42 of 9.5 km, pace 4'52", 156 bpm, 31:14, a Zone 3 tag
The four link columns and the legal row below the panel are clean and correctly quiet; one typeface (Plus Jakarta Sans) throughout
Copy has a point of view: 'Coaching for people who run before work and lift after it'
slop_signals: 'New · Adaptive half-marathon plans' pill badge above the headline, in a footer
Headline mixes weights for 'counting on you.'
A tilted phone with two floating cards (VO2 max trend, '18 day streak, keep it going') at different angles and shadows, over decorative concentric rings
Five green stars, '4.9 from 38,200 ratings' and '14 days free': invented social proof
Two generic black store-style badges plus a QR code plus 'Scan to install': three ways to say install
The cobalt panel is the hero template (badge, headline, sub, buttons, proof, device) moved to the bottom of the page
fixes: Straighten the phone and crop it hard at the panel's bottom edge, as the direction's own reference does; remove the floating cards and the rings
Remove the pill badge and the mixed weight; shorten the panel so it is a band, not a second hero
Keep the QR code and one install badge; drop the rating line until there is a real one, or state a real count plainly
Consider no panel at all: the QR and store badges beside the link columns, as Function and Shop do, with the phone shown elsewhere on the site

references.what: A QR code and real store badges sit beside the link columns in a card; no phone, no floating cards
'Get the app with 500K 5-star reviews' with one big QR, then plain columns with badges; the proof is a number, not stars
'Enjoy fitness on the go' plus two store badges inside the footer columns; the install ask at footer scale
Four store badges stacked as their own column; install as a list, not a pitch
Store badges and licence marks in one row above a giant wordmark; a fintech app footer without a device render
